title: SpeechGym: An Audio-Native Gym for Training Voice Agents via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Voice agents must call tools and hold multi-turn dialogue entirely through speech, yet the dominant paradigm trains them in text. Existing frameworks either cascade TTS and ASR around a proprietary voice API, where gradients cannot flow and per-call cost makes on-policy reinforcement learning prohibitive, or stay in text: they measure voice agents but cannot improve them. We present SpeechGym, an audio-native agentic environment in which two omni-modal models converse in native audio, with no external ASR or TTS and no API boundary, over the unmodified tasks, tools and success check of an established text agentic benchmark, so that the interaction modality is the only variable and the loop stays local and trainable end to end. Audio agentic capability does not follow from audio understanding. translated_title: SpeechGym：一个通过强化学习训练语音代理的音频原生健身房
translated_abstract: 语音代理必须完全通过语音调用工具并进行多轮对话，然而主流范式却是在文本中训练它们。现有框架要么在专有语音API周围级联TTS和ASR，其中梯度无法流动且每次调用的成本使在线策略强化学习变得不可行，要么停留在文本层面：它们能测量语音代理却无法改进它们。我们提出了SpeechGym，一个音频原生的代理环境，其中两个全模态模型以原生音频进行对话，无需外部ASR或TTS，也没有API边界，在既定文本代理基准的未修改任务、工具和成功检查上运行，因此交互模态是唯一变量，且循环保持本地化并可端到端训练。音频代理能力并非源于音频理解。语音引入的失败是感知性而非推理性缺陷：代理选择了正确的工具和正确的参数槽，但填充...
tldr: 本文提出SpeechGym，一个音频原生的代理环境，通过强化学习端到端训练语音代理，解决了现有框架无法在音频模态中改进代理能力的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SpeechGym, an audio-native agentic environment that enables end-to-end reinforcement learning for voice agents, addressing the limitation of existing frameworks that cannot improve agents in the audio modality.
